record.what_it_does: Sales CRM for SMBs with calling, email, SMS, sequences and pipelines.
record.auth_notes: API keys are sent with HTTP Basic Auth. Each key is tied to one user and one org, and keys suit scripts. OAuth 2.0 suits user-facing integrations: refresh tokens come with offline_access and the scope gives full access. The MCP server supports OAuth 2.0 with DCR, and also an API key in the Close-API-Key header.
record.access_notes: Close has no free plan, but a 14-day trial needs no credit card. Pricing lists "High-volume API access" as not included on Solo and included on Essentials and above. API keys and private OAuth apps are self-serve inside your own org. Before other Close customers can authorize an OAuth app, Close must review it ("Make Public and submit for review"). Close gives integration partners free dev orgs on request (email support@close.com), and existing users can create a free secondary org.
record.api_breadth_notes: Covers leads, contacts, opportunities, activities (email, SMS, call, notes), sequences, tasks, bulk actions, reporting, custom fields, users and orgs, webhooks and the event log. A public OpenAPI 3.1 spec is available in JSON and YAML. Operations were not counted exactly, but there are well over 50.
record.mcp_notes: The URL is https://mcp.close.com/mcp, over Streamable HTTP. Auth is OAuth 2.0 with DCR, or an API key in the Close-API-Key header. Scopes are mcp.read, mcp.write_safe and mcp.write_destructive. I confirmed this on developer.close.com/mcp. The docs site also has its own docs MCP at developer.close.com/_mcp/server.
record.blocker_notes: The API is broad, the OpenAPI spec is public and building is self-serve. A free dev org is available on request, or you can use the 14-day trial. A public multi-tenant OAuth app needs Close's review before other organizations can authorize it.

evidence.quote: API keys for scripts or OAuth 2.0 for user-facing integrations.
OAuth apps are Private by default, meaning only members of your own Close organization can authorize them.
Click Make Public and submit for review.
work identically to standard Close organizations but have no subscription fees
raw OpenAPI 3.1 specification for this API, JSON format
Real-time event notifications and a 30-day event log.
The MCP server URL is https://mcp.close.com/mcp
